entities.summary: Marie Elisabeth Kuylenstierna-Wenster was a Swedish translator and writer, often writing under the pseudonym Sten Wide or using her initials EKW. She studied in France, Germany, and Denmark and wrote for several magazines in the period 1886–1913. She then became a French teacher and was a common lecturer at the municipality before she became a popular science lecturer in Lund.
